card.name: Al-Ayyala
card.profile: Two rows of ~20 men with thin bamboo canes (as spears) face each other while drummers between play; men sway heads and sticks and chant poetry, simulating battle. Joint Oman/UAE, UNESCO 2014. Composite performing art (poetry+drum+dance).
